picks.name: I. JORDAN
picks.source_note: Peach Discs already seeded. New artist discovery -- I. JORDAN's label debut. Exact Bandcamp release-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link uses the label's already-confirmed Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "Soft Serve Summer" (July 17, 2026, Peach Discs) is I. JORDAN's debut EP for the label -- four original tracks (lead single "Your Love") plus a closing remix of "Little Tinker" from label co-founder Gramrcy, showcasing a brighter, housier, more personal side of her sound.
picks.why_listen: Sun-soaked, melodic house from a UK garage-rooted producer stepping into a warmer register -- good for a bright, feel-good stretch of a set.
